items.title: [BUG] build-with-exit-guard test fails and npm run build can pass on a stale dist
items.description: scripts/build-with-exit-guard.test.mjs:68 expected exit 2, got 0, reproducible alone; scripts/ is untouched by the social branch. In the same run npm run build exited 0 with 'ng build hung after completing output' while dist held chunks from an earlier build, so a green build there proved nothing. Not yet checked on main.
